steps.title: Open the tape cockpit
steps.narration: This is Tapeology — a live read of one stock's order flow that tells you who is in control of the tape. It opens clean, with nothing watched yet, so you just type a ticker to begin.
steps.point_out: The Tapeology header with the ticker box and the green Watch button, and the calm 'No ticker watched' idle screen — no panels populated yet.

steps.title: Type the choppy sample ticker
steps.narration: Let's start with the honest case. We enter SIM-CHOP — a deliberately messy, two-sided tape with no clear winner.
steps.point_out: SIM-CHOP typed into the ticker box, ready to watch.

steps.title: Watch SIM-CHOP settle on "Unclear"
steps.narration: We hit Watch and the cockpit fills with live data — but instead of forcing a call, it honestly reads 'Unclear' at low confidence. When the tape is genuinely choppy, the product says so rather than faking a direction. This is the honesty the whole tool is built around.
steps.point_out: The amber 'Unclear' headline, the low confidence reading (0.200), balanced buy/sell pressure near 0.50 with 0.0 price impact, and the 'Mixed or weak evidence — no clear side in control' note. No buyer, seller, or absorption call is made.

steps.title: Switch to the buyer sample
steps.narration: Now the opposite — a clean, decisive tape. We type SIM-BUYER into the same box.
steps.point_out: SIM-BUYER entered in the ticker box, replacing the previous ticker.

steps.title: Watch SIM-BUYER announce "Buyer Control"
steps.narration: The cockpit reads 'Buyer Control' in green and announces the change live in the event log the moment it resolves — aggressive buying is genuinely lifting the price.
steps.point_out: The green 'Buyer Control' headline with a high confidence bar, and the 'Tape state changed to buyer_control' line appearing in the Event Log — the live transition.

steps.title: Switch to the seller sample
steps.narration: Next we flip to the mirror case and type SIM-SELLER.
steps.point_out: SIM-SELLER entered in the ticker box.

steps.title: Watch SIM-SELLER flip to "Seller Control"
steps.narration: The read flips to 'Seller Control' in red — sellers are pressing and the price is dropping — with its own live transition note in the log.
steps.point_out: The red 'Seller Control' headline and the 'Tape state changed to seller_control' line in the Event Log.

steps.title: Switch to the bid-absorption sample
steps.narration: Now the product's signature call. We type SIM-BIDABS — heavy selling that meets a price which simply refuses to fall.
steps.point_out: SIM-BIDABS entered in the ticker box.

steps.title: Watch SIM-BIDABS read "Bid Absorption"
steps.narration: Despite a flood of selling, the price holds — so the cockpit reads 'Bid Absorption' in amber. The call rests on whether the price actually moved, not on how much aggression there was: pressure being soaked up, not control.
steps.point_out: The amber 'Bid Absorption' headline; the price holding at 100.00 while heavy sells print, and notes like 'Heavy sell volume being absorbed' / 'Bid refreshing at 100.00'.

steps.title: Switch to the ask-absorption sample
steps.narration: The mirror of absorption. We type SIM-ASKABS — heavy buying that fails to lift the price.
steps.point_out: SIM-ASKABS entered in the ticker box.

steps.title: Watch SIM-ASKABS read "Ask Absorption"
steps.narration: Heavy buying that stalls at the ask reads as 'Ask Absorption' in amber — buyers being absorbed rather than taking control. That completes the full set of five tape situations the cockpit can recognise.
steps.point_out: The amber 'Ask Absorption' headline; the price stalling at 100.02 despite buy prints, and notes like 'Heavy buy volume being absorbed'.

steps.title: Try an unknown ticker
steps.narration: Finally, the honesty guardrail. We type a ticker the system doesn't recognise — NOPE-XYZ.
steps.point_out: NOPE-XYZ entered in the ticker box.

steps.title: Unknown ticker is refused, not faked
steps.narration: Instead of inventing a tape, the cockpit refuses cleanly with a plain error and stays idle. It never fabricates a reading for a stock it doesn't know.
steps.point_out: The rose error line "'NOPE-XYZ' is not a known simulated ticker" under the header, and the empty cockpit — no panels and no fabricated tape state.

expect.text: is not a known simulated ticker
